blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — If he knew that his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, had business interests with food company Gencorp Industries Incorporated, which dealt with Davao City, then that contract would not have prospered. This is what Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte said on Tuesday as he testified in the impeachment trial. Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis Escudero intervened for the prosecution, asking Mayor Duterte himself as the defense panel complained that prosecution counsel, Theodore Te, had been asking repetitive questions. Escudero then informed Mayor Duterte that previous witnesses testified that while Vice President Sara Duterte had mentioned in her Statement of Assets, […]...
